steps.title: Prepare reagents at room temperature
steps.instruction: Remove Qubit RNA HS assay kit, RNAClean XP beads, NEBNext quick ligation buffer, and the Flongle flow cell from the refrigerator and let them equilibrate at room temperature for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Thaw frozen ONT reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw the following ONT reagents as indicated: RT adapter (RTA) on ice, RNA adapter mix (RMX) on ice, Wash buffer (WSB) at room temperature, Elution buffer (ELB) at room temperature, RNA running buffer (RRB) at room temperature, Flush tether (FLT) at room temperature, and Flush buffer (FB) at room temperature.

steps.title: Extract total RNA from viral stock
steps.instruction: Using the MagMAX CORE Nucleic Acid Purification kit on a KingFisher Duo Prime, extract total genomic RNA from 200 µL of frozen FMDV viral stock for each isolate and elute in 70 µL of the kit’s elution buffer.

steps.title: Quantify extracted RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration with a Qubit 4 fluorometer using the Qubit RNA High‑Sensitivity assay kit, following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: First ligation (primer annealing)
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL LoBind tube add 3 µL 5× NEBNext quick ligation reaction buffer, 9.5 µL extracted RNA, 1 µL RT adapter (RTA) and 1.5 µL T4 DNA ligase (2 M U/mL). Mix by pipetting, briefly spin (≈1 s), and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare ligation buffer and ethanol
steps.instruction: While the first ligation incubates, make 30 µL of 1× ligation buffer by mixing 6 µL 5× NEBNext buffer with 24 µL nuclease‑free water. Prepare 70 % ethanol by mixing 140 µL molecular‑grade ethanol with 60 µL nuclease‑free water (150 µL will be used per wash).

steps.title: Bead cleanup of first ligation
steps.instruction: After the 10‑min incubation, add 25 µL of the 1× ligation buffer to the ligation tube (final volume 40 µL). Add 72 µL RNAClean XP beads (1:1.8 bead‑to‑sample ratio). Mix, shake on a Scilogex mixer at ~300 rpm for 5 min at room temperature, then place on a magnetic stand for ~1.5 min. Remove and discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 150 µL 70 % ethanol (rotate tube 180° twice per wash), and remove residual ethanol by brief centrifugation and pipetting. Remove the tube from the magnet, add 23.5 µL nuclease‑free water, shake at ~300 rpm for 2 min at room temperature, centrifuge briefly, and pellet on the magnetic stand for ~1.5 min. Transfer 23 µL eluate to a new LoBind tube.

steps.title: Second ligation (sequencing adapters)
steps.instruction: To the purified RNA from the previous step add 8 µL 5× NEBNext quick ligation reaction buffer, 6 µL RNA adapter mix (RMX) and 3 µL T4 DNA ligase (2 M U/mL). Mix by pipetting, briefly spin, and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Bead cleanup of adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL RNAClean XP beads (1:1 ratio) to the ligation reaction, mix, and shake at ~300 rpm for 5 min at room temperature. Place on a magnetic stand for ~1.5 min, remove supernatant, and add 150 µL Wash buffer (WSB). Resuspend beads by flicking, spin briefly, and re‑magnetize; discard supernatant. Repeat the WSB wash once more. After the second wash, remove residual WSB, add 17 µL Elution buffer (ELB), shake at ~300 rpm for 2 min at room temperature, centrifuge, and pellet on the magnetic stand for ~1.5 min. Transfer the 17 µL library to a new LoBind tube (optional: measure 1 µL with Qubit HS RNA kit).

steps.title: Prepare and load Flongle flow cell
steps.instruction: Place the Flongle flow cell (ensure ≥50 active pores) on the MinION Mk1C or GridION with the Flongle adapter. In a clean tube combine 117 µL Flush buffer (FB) with 3 µL Flush tether (FLT), vortex, and briefly centrifuge. Load 120 µL of this flush mixture into the Flongle sample port using a 200 µL pipette, avoiding air bubbles.

steps.title: Load library and start sequencing run
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of RNA running buffer (RRB) to the 17 µL purified library (i.e., 17 µL RRB), mix gently, and briefly centrifuge. Load the entire library‑plus‑running‑buffer mixture into the Flongle sample port, seal the port, and start the run in MinKNOW (default settings, version 21.05.12, with adaptive sampling enabled). The run may proceed for up to 24 hours; full‑genome coverage is typically observed within 25 minutes of runtime.
